subject: Important Update: Changes to our Customer Support Hours
body: Dear valued customers, I hope this email finds you well. We wanted to inform you about some upcoming changes to our customer support hours. Starting next week, our support team will be available from 8am to 8pm on weekdays and from 9am to 5pm on weekends. We believe this adjustment will help us serve you better and provide assistance when you need it the most. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. Thank you for your understanding and continued support.
